messages:
Sam (Sales): Quick handoff for KeelCo 12-month deal signed. Key asks: Okta SSO, private VPC peering, and predictably low tail latency for their in-app summarization. CFO asked for monthly cost breakdown for reserved vs hosted. Tagging Priya to own.
Priya (CS): On it. Short context: expected 5k MAU first quarter, ramp to 30k. Primary workload: realtime summarization + few embedding calls. Sales notes: https://redwood.app/internal/keelco (internal only).
Sam (Sales): They emphasized p95 < 250ms for summaries and willing to pay for reserved capacity if we can guarantee it. Peak simultaneous users ~80, expected sustained QPS ~15.
Marco (Solutions): Thanks. I'll draft two infra options: Dedicated (n1 GPUs, reserved) + hybrid fallback to hosted for overflow; and Hosted with autoscale + prefixed cache for summaries. Need avg seq len and expected token mix.
Priya (CS): Avg seq ~90 tokens for summaries, embeddings low. Also: they want a pilot in 2 weeks. I'll schedule kickoff tomorrow.
Lee (Support): Ill prep an ops checklist and monitoring dashboard. Propose thresholds: p50/p95/p99, error rate, token spend budget alerts, and a cache-hit metric. Will add runbook for failover to hosted when dedicated pool saturated.
Ruth (FinanceBot): Finance note: customer asked for line-itemed monthly TCO including instance costs, quantization savings, and expected egress. Use our TCO calculator: https://finance.redwood.internal/tco.
Priya (CS): Action owners: Sam: intro to KeelCo security lead (due today). Marco: draft ENG ticket with two config options + TCO (48h). Lee: runbook + dashboard skeleton (48h). Priya: pilot schedule + internal dry-run (24h).
Sam (Sales): Security POC is Jordan Park (jordan@keelco.com). I'll intro now.
Marco (Solutions): Creating ENG-6992 "KeelCo dedicated vs hosted options". I'll include estimated token cost delta: int8 vs fp16 and note quality tradeoffs on our eval set.
Lee (Support): Runbook stub added: "monitors: p50/p95/p99 latency, request failures, token cost per call, cache hit ratio. Alerts: p95 > 300ms x5m, error rate > 1%". Adding to ENG-6992.
Priya (CS): Renewal risk flag: CFO cares about unit economics. Add a transparent monthly billing projection and a success metric for renewal (p95 < 300ms and <2% error and monthly cost variance <10%).
Ruth (FinanceBot): Suggested billing breakdown: reserved infra, support SLA premium, monitoring & log retention. I can run a sample quote if ENG-6992 includes projected token volumes.
Marco (Solutions): Note about caching: for summarization we can memoize prefixes for repeated doc types; expected cache hit could be 20-30% which reduces load. Will include in config.
Sam (Sales): Customer trial scope: 2-week pilot, up to 2k users, limited dataset. Priya please confirm scope with Jordan.
Priya (CS): Will confirm. Also adding a customer feedback capture plan during pilot: short NPS pulse after pilot, plus a 5-question product feedback form.
Lee (Support): During pilot I'll enable synthetic traffic to validate tail latency and run canary alerts. Need Okta metadata and network CIDR for peering.
Sam (Sales): Jordan will share Okta metadata and network contact. Sending intro now.
Priya (CS): Summary of next steps: 1) Sam: intro email to Jordan + share pilot scope (today) 2) Marco: open ENG-6992 + TCO options (48h) 3) Lee: runbook + dashboards + canary scripts (48h) 4) Priya: schedule kickoff + customer pilot plan + feedback form (24h).
Priya (CS): Can we reconvene in this thread when ENG-6992 is ready? :rocket:
Marco (Solutions): Yes. I'll ping when the ticket draft and config snippets are uploaded.
Lee (Support): Acknowledged. I'll post dashboard links here once available.
Ruth (FinanceBot): Reminder: follow-up in 48h to attach pricing quote.
Sam (Sales): Thanks everyone 1 — excited to get KeelCo live.
